sections.value: NOW THIS DEED WITNESSES AS FOLLOWS:
PARTITION AND GRANT TO THE FIRST PARTY

In pursuance of the said agreement and in consideration of the premises, the Second Party as Beneficial Owner hereby conveys, releases, and confirms unto the First Party ALL THAT {{propertyDescription}} situate at {{propertyAddress}}, which is more particularly described in the Schedule hereto; TO HOLD the same unto and to the use of the First Party in severalty and absolutely, discharged from all claims and demands of the Second Party.
COVENANTS FOR TITLE AND QUIET ENJOYMENT

value:
1. Each Party hereby covenants with the other that the Party so covenanting has not done or permitted any act or thing whereby the portion released to the other Party is or may be encumbered or prejudicially affected in title, estate, or otherwise.

2. The First Party shall peaceably and quietly hold, possess, and enjoy the partitioned portion without any lawful eviction, interruption, or disturbance from the Second Party or any person rightfully claiming under or in trust for the Second Party.

3. The Parties shall execute such further documents or do such acts as may be reasonably required to perfectly vest title of the partitioned portion in the First Party.

sections.value: The Parties agree that the original Deed of Assignment covering the Entire Property shall remain in the custody of the First Party, who hereby gives an acknowledgment of the right of the other Party to the production of the same and to delivery of copies thereof, and an undertaking for its safe custody.
